text: Horror scavenger hunt activated through a fictional room sheet that leads participants to the highest point of the Eina Bosc tower, where they can pick up a portal that lets them access another level of the Backrooms and that also includes a link to my master's thesis.

The Tower is level 362 of the Backrooms, and is characterised by an –apparently– endless staircase where you can get trapped. Legend says it's an access point to many other levels if you manage to dodge the challenges that try to stop you from reaching the end. Beware of The Watcher: it has no face and tries to get one, and if you stare at it, it might be yours it keeps.
As part of the research on the Backrooms.
